sources.finding: The scalar count members lack in-class initializers; the constructor only conditionally allocates detailed results; getters directly return these members.

Every update advances update_count. variablesRelinearized is explicitly zeroed then set to markedKeys.size on scheduled checks. variablesReeliminated is assigned inside recalculation branches, not at update entry; no marked/observed keys can bypass these assignments.
Without force_relinearize, the enabled check uses update_count modulo relinearizeSkip equal to zero.

installed_behavior: Independent tiny-graph reproduction and real empty updates return out-of-range values, consistent with the official-tag no-work path. Do not interpret them as operation counts.
binary_provenance_limit: Installed package reports4.2; exact wheel binary-to-source build identity and individual C++ branch execution were not instrumented. In-range reelimination values can still be uninitialized by coincidence.
relinearization_interpretation: A returned positive marked-set count is not an exact count of poses whose coordinates changed, nor an independent proof that every counted pose was retracted.
